# Thomas Dall Archival Dataset Summary

This dataset provides comprehensive automated transcript indexing, social media logs, and crowdsourced archiving matrices.

## Core Statistics
- **Primary Forensic Transcripts:** 337 assets indexed
- **Archived Twitter/X Posts:** 942 entries stored
- **Secondary Commentary & Satire Logs:** 0 assets indexed
